source_summary: A misty snow landscape with central textured mountains, pale distant peaks, foreground trees and rocks, a low snowy crossing, waterline strokes, and a small boat. Red seals, calligraphy, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_snow_mountain_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large central cluster of snow-capped mountains with multiple rounded peaks and steep vertical cliff faces, including the dense dark texture strokes on the slopes and the pale reserved snow areas.
must_preserve: rounded snow-blanketed peak silhouettes
dense stippled leaf-like texture marks across upper slopes
vertical cliff cracks and dry-brush rock striations
soft grey wash transitions at mountain bases
unpainted pale snow reserves between inked ridges

motifs.name: left_distant_snow_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the pale, mist-softened ridge behind the main mountain on the left, with its low undulating outline and faint ink contouring.
must_preserve: thin wavering ridge contour
very light grey wash on the snow face
soft disappearance into mist at the lower edge
minimal dry-brush texture near the base

motifs.name: right_isolated_mist_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the solitary pale peak on the right side, standing behind the foreground mist, with a jagged crest and light vertical side contour.
must_preserve: jagged snow crest outline
pale interior wash
thin right-side contour line
mist-softened lower boundary
small dark texture accents near the lower left edge

motifs.name: left_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove at the lower left with layered shrubs, bare trunks, dark foliage clusters, and a few muted reddish-brown leaf accents, including the rocky base beneath it.
must_preserve: interlaced bare tree trunks and branches
dark clustered foliage dots
muted reddish-brown leaf accents
rocky base with grey washes and angular ink lines
overlapping shrub masses of varying density

motifs.name: foreground_snow_bank_waterlines
motifs.description: Isolate the low horizontal snowy bank and water surface strokes across the lower left and middle foreground, excluding the large diagonal rock mass and seals.
must_preserve: thin horizontal waterline strokes
pale snowy negative space between ink lines
small dark stones on the bank
broken dry-brush shoreline marks
subtle grey wash along the water edge

motifs.name: center_low_bridge_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the small low bridge or crossing at the center foreground with the arcing line, short vertical supports, and dotted shrubs rising behind it.
must_preserve: curving bridge or crossing line
short vertical support strokes beneath the crossing
dense dotted shrub foliage above and behind
fine twig-like branch lines
snowy gaps left between shrub clusters

motifs.name: diagonal_foreground_rock_slab
motifs.description: Isolate the large diagonal foreground rock or fallen slab extending from lower center toward the right, with attached smaller rocks and water strokes around its base.
must_preserve: long diagonal dry-brush striations
pale snow-covered upper plane
dark angular rock texture at the right end
cluster of smaller stones along the bottom edge
thin surrounding water ripples

motifs.name: small_right_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small empty boat at the lower right floating on the water, including its ribbed interior strokes and the nearby waterline marks.
must_preserve: slender pointed hull shape
short rib-like interior ink strokes
small upright post or oar mark
faint horizontal water ripples around the boat
delicate dry-brush outline

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
